coverage.scope: British Standards and UK-adopted EN/IEC standards relevant to this fire and security archive, including electrical and cabling, social alarms, powered entrances, sprinklers and gas suppression. Companion PD and DD technical specifications are explicitly identified. Consultation drafts have a separate watchlist.
limits: This is a checked register, not a complete catalogue of every British Standard or every historical amendment.
Edition headings and publisher statuses are verified against public BSI records. Detailed changes are summarized only where the publisher supplies a public summary.
An A-number in a designation records that amendment; it is not a complete list of earlier amendments or separate corrigenda.
A publisher record date can refer to a corrected issue or product record and can differ from the year in the designation. It is not an effective or withdrawal date.
Under review does not mean withdrawn. Drafts do not replace published standards. A newer edition does not establish a withdrawal date for an earlier one.
Full standard texts require the publisher licence. Offline search stores this metadata and these original short summaries, not licensed standards PDFs.
remaining_checks: Complete amendment, corrigendum and supersession histories from publisher history panels or licensed copies; an amendment suffix alone is not a full history.
Formal withdrawal/coexistence dates where BSI still shows both older and newer records as current, including the 2026 intercom, sprinkler and bonding editions.
Any further product-specific parts or sector requirements outside the families in this checked register. This is not the entire BSI catalogue.
The outcome of the separately listed 2026 consultation drafts. Do not use a draft as a published replacement.
